Standard: Mass notifications will be recognized and understood at all crewmember seats, passenger seats, lavatories, workstations and other accessible compartments under all anticipated ambient noise conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
(1) Conduct a demonstration in a production representative air vehicle or control station to verify that the mass notifications are recognized and understood on first presentation from all crewmember seats, passenger seats, lavatories, workstations and other accessible compartments under all anticipated ambient noise and lighting conditions and with crewmember equipment. The demonstration will be in flight for manned air vehicles.
